args.message: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212)

args.head: fix-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` uses ROUND_HALF_UP.

This change updates `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so that values like `2.665` round to `2.66` (banker's rounding) as expected.

CI is passing on the branch.
